jobs.prompt: Correct this exact BRINE Core L-shaped console (image 1). Image 2 is ONLY color and room context reference: match its pearl-white core chamber and pale cabinetry, not its room composition. The current console coating is too beige/dark: repaint opaque housings neutral softly warm pearl white, pale midtones around RGB 224 221 216, natural gray recesses. Do NOT globally brighten dark teal screens, rubber seals or fluid. Remove golden/beige cast. Diffuse matte painted finish; soften thick black borders and hard bevels, eliminate cylinder shine stripes and glowy highlights; preserve readable construction. GEOMETRY correction: outer top and outer left edges stay straight for square walls. Shorten the horizontal north run inward/free end by approximately 8 percent, intelligently compact redundant bezel spaces rather than miniaturize functional modules. Preserve compact downward return length. Target overall width:height approximately 138:132. Preserve an L, return down left, open inner corner, same supported cutaway perspective and recognizable life-support/analysis equipment. Sparse readable detailing suitable for a 400-pixel export; no tiny new controls. Full isolated silhouette on TRUE transparent background and transparent inner void, small margins. No room, floor, people, exterior shadows or labels. Preserve original major modules, muted teal, and shallow interior side depth.
